name: sendhog
description: SendHog public API and provider-shaped SDK subset. Own bearer authentication; not upstream wire/auth emulation. Sending remains operationally gated.

methods.name: sendBulk
methods.summary: Send one personalized email per recipient using a published template. Waits for SES acceptance, returns ordered individual outcomes. Idempotency-Key required; never automatically retries email.

methods.name: getBulk
methods.summary: Inspect outcomes from a bulk send in the key domain without resending.

methods.name: messageEvents
methods.summary: Read retained email events for an owned message, newest first. Events are retained for 30 days.

methods.name: createWebhook
methods.summary: Register a public HTTPS endpoint for signed email events. Returns the signing secret once.

methods.name: deleteWebhook
methods.summary: Delete a domain-owned webhook and cancel pending deliveries.

methods.name: send
methods.summary: Send inline subject/text/html or a published domain-scoped template ID/slug with variables. Verified domains receive automatic sending approval; account limits, disable controls and normal dispatch safeguards apply.

methods.name: listMessages
methods.summary: List retained email metadata and text in the key's domain, with a stable forward cursor.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.summary: Read one retained message in the key's domain. A foreign or missing ID returns 404.

providers.name: SendHog
providers.note: Default: send(message) with inline subject/text/html OR template:{id,variables,version?} referencing a published SendHog domain template. Returns id/created_at directly. Optional cc/bcc/replyTo (Python reply_to). messages.list/get reads retained mail. No command objects, React node payloads or data/error wrapper.

providers.name: Amazon SES
providers.note: SES v2 Simple only. Use SendHog setup and SendEmailCommand; no AWS authentication. messages.list/get is a SendHog extension.

providers.name: Postmark
providers.note: Postmark JS ServerClient and current async Python outbound.send subset. Only the outbound transactional stream; no templates, tracking or attachments.

providers.name: Resend
providers.note: JS returns data/error; Python returns the id dictionary. Supports inline html/text OR template:{id,variables,version?} with published SendHog IDs/slugs (not Resend-owned templates). No React rendering, scheduling, provider idempotency options or attachments.

providers.name: SendGrid
providers.note: JS simple mail helper subset; Python raw dictionary with one personalization/envelope. JS returns response/body pair; Python returns status_code, headers, body. No multiple personalizations, bulk, templates or helper-object emulation.

receiving.note: Reads retained metadata/text only. No SES/SendGrid inbox API is invented; upstream inbound webhook, attachment and MIME parity are not claimed.
